tools.name: search_parts
tools.description: Search the Drivestock B2B catalog (inverters/Umrichter, servo, PLC/controls, sensors, spare parts). Requires q and/or brand. Returns up to 50 hits with net EUR display prices or "auf Anfrage" (on request). brand_shop=mechstock is not live yet.

tools.name: get_part
tools.description: Get one catalog part by sku (part number) or brand+part_number. Includes per-condition net prices or "auf Anfrage", product URL, and basic specs when available.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: List manufacturers/brands in the live Drivestock catalog with part counts and categories. Optional prefix filter (e.g. "Sie" → Siemens).

tools.name: get_brand_stats
tools.description: Catalog statistics: omit brand for all brands overview; pass brand for part counts by category and how many SKUs have a display price.

tools.name: suggest_alternatives
tools.description: Suggest similar/alternative parts for a SKU (same brand/category/part-number prefix). Useful when the exact type is unavailable or for cross-checks. Max 20.

tools.name: create_inquiry
tools.description: Create a real B2B quote inquiry / Angebotsanfrage (same backend as the website form). Persists the request and emails the Drivestock team (irreversible notify). Always set source: grok | claude | chatgpt | cursor | other. sku (Teilenummer) required.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_part · Public sink: create_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_part · Public sink: create_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
